arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Mr. Estrada argued the Eleventh Circuit erred in granting immunity.
Mr. Himmelfarb cited precedent establishing that cities and counties lack immunity.
Mr. Hart argued delegated sovereign functions create residual immunity.
